## AI / Robotics / Semiconductor News

- [OpenAI secured a $110 billion funding round](https://36kr.com/newsflashes/3702448565186945), more than doubling its valuation to $730 billion with major investments from Amazon ($50B), NVIDIA ($30B), and SoftBank ($30B), underscoring dominant market positioning and accelerating AI hardware and infrastructure development.
- [OpenAI revealed further details about its Pentagon agreement](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/01/openai-shares-more-details-about-its-agreement-with-the-pentagon/), highlighting strategic deployment of its models in classified environments with safeguards against mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, positioning the company as a key defense AI player and raising regulatory risk considerations for investors.
- [Anthropic’s Claude surged to No. 1 in the US App Store](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/01/anthropics-claude-rises-to-no-2-in-the-app-store-following-pentagon-dispute/) following a Pentagon dispute over AI safety, driving a 60%+ increase in free users and more than doubling paid subscribers YTD, reflecting rapid market growth amid heightened regulatory scrutiny.
- [The US military ordered contractors and agencies to cease business with Anthropic](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/03/01/media/trump-iran-media-sunday-shows-white-house) due to Pentagon AI safety concerns, potentially impacting Anthropic’s market position and future funding prospects in defense-related AI.
- [Investors are pulling back from AI SaaS companies](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/01/investors-spill-what-they-aren-t-looking-for-anymore-in-ai-saas-companies/), citing sustainability concerns and shifting market interest, which could dampen valuations and growth prospects for SaaS-focused AI firms.
- [Robotics and automation companies saw increased funding and product launches](https://www.cnbc.com/ai-age/), with OpenAI’s $110B round and major backing from Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank, driving competitive positioning and signaling robust investor confidence despite regulatory and geopolitical tensions.
- [China’s Honor unveiled the Robot Phone with a robotic camera arm](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/01/honor-robot-phone-magic-v6-foldable-launch-mwc.html) and teased a humanoid robot, targeting high-end markets amid chip shortages and intensifying competition with Samsung and Apple, especially in Europe.
- [AI sports technology company 'Zhi Jing Wei' completed over 100 million yuan Pre-A funding](https://36kr.com/newsflashes/3701240114720390) and [over 100 million yuan pre-IPO financing](https://36kr.com/p/3705039542710665), signaling strong investor confidence and positioning for global expansion and potential IPO in the AI-driven sports and health tech sector.
- [AI-powered mental health platform 'Wangli Technology' raised hundreds of millions in Series C funding](https://36kr.com/p/3670040712094601), with regulatory approval for its AI-based anti-depression product and national guideline recommendations, indicating significant growth potential in digital psychiatric care.
- [AI and advanced manufacturing company 'Shenzhen Baiyi Innovation' completed a multi-million yuan pre-IPO round](https://36kr.com/newsflashes/3705036188184963), reflecting strong investor interest and increased order volumes in AI-driven manufacturing solutions ahead of a potential IPO.
- [AI and optical technology firm 'Hao Na Optoelectronics' completed over 100 million yuan Series B financing](https://36kr.com/p/3701173054566018), aiming to expand in optical communication, robotics, and AI medical devices, and strengthening its supply chain for high-end glass aspheric lenses.
- [AI and metal 3D printing company 'Zhongke Xianglong' secured multiple financing rounds within a year](https://36kr.com/p/3698152296410756), supporting R&D in AI-driven design and advanced metal 3D printing for aerospace and high-end manufacturing, with order books filled through 2027 and expanding market share in additive manufacturing.
